# event-tracker
> Event buffer with batched flush, auto-flush on size/interval, and retry-once sink

Event buffer with batched flush to a pluggable async sink. Triggers on batch size or flush interval (unref'd timer). Retries failed flushes once; failed events are re-queued. Manual flush and graceful close (drain).

## API
- `TrackedEvent`
- `EventSink`
- `EventTrackerOptions`
- `EventTracker`

## Install
Each library is a standalone GitHub repo under github.com/Ruzylo-cloud.

Part of the Ferrow open-source toolkit: https://github.com/Ruzylo-cloud/ferrow-toolkit — sponsored by https://ferrow.ai
